lead: Muppavarapu Venkaiah Naidu has built a public profile as an Indian politician, born on 1 July 1949 in Nellore.
As of 2026, he is 77 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Minister of Information and Broadcasting and has been recognised with the Padma Vibhushan.
The sections that follow break down Muppavarapu Venkaiah Naidu's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Muppavarapu Venkaiah Naidu — Career and Professional Work
paras: Muppavarapu Venkaiah Naidu works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (1998–2017), Minister of Information and Broadcasting (2016–2017), Minister of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation (2014–2017), Minister of Rural Development (2000–2002), Minister of Urban Development (2014–2017) and Minister of Parliamentary Affairs (2014–2016). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
